name: Promoter
oneLine: The on/off switch in front of a gene.
howItWorks: The promoter is a short run of letters the polymerase recognises. Where it binds, copying starts. Block the promoter and the gene goes silent.
deeper: Bacterial promoters have two short signal boxes. Proteins that sit on or near them turn genes up or down.
sizeComparison: a 7,000th the width of a hair
simplification: Switches are shown as simple toggles. Real control is a dimmer, not on/off.
